log.msg: Dawn, day 1. Snowbound Taiga. Always cold. Snow can be melted for water if you have fuel.
Somewhere to the north there is a town. Find it: its people know what this land is waiting for.
Your camp has a well. A cloak, a lantern and fuel are stored here: open Pack to take them.
You pass the gate of Stonewall. The elder will be at the hall on the north side of the square.
